大家好,我是张慧老师今天要和各位来聊一个比较沉重的话题自杀近日安徽省16岁的高三女孩在清晨5点从教学楼5楼的窗户坠楼学校发生坠楼之后立马拨打了120但是在120赶到现场后该同学已经没有了生命体征民警初步勘察后排除他杀据媒体报道很可能是因为孩子学业压力过大再加上老师前两天的训斥在多方压力之下最终选择了自杀事实上自杀的人生前多少都会透露出亲身的意象但是很多时候呀因为周围的人缺乏相关的知识没有觉察而错失了挽回他们的最佳时期所以今天就自杀前的预警信号来给大家做一个分享目前心理学研究发现自杀分为两种情况一种是冲动型自杀一种是蓄谋已久的自杀所谓冲动型自杀一般是在自杀念头出现之后不久立马采取自杀行为这种自杀行为有没有发生跟当时所处的环境有非常大的关系比如20年9月初刚开学的时候有一名武汉的14岁男孩被母亲在学校走廊扇耳光之后立马翻栏杆跳楼自杀这种自杀征兆呢是在剧烈的冲突之后孩子发生了明显的情绪变化这会儿孩子完全处于一个恼乐的状态有两种类型的小孩需要特别注意一下第一种就是处在青春期的孩子这个阶段下呢他们的情绪起伏是非常大的而且自尊心很强极为敏感所以针对青春期的孩子在沟通上需要特别注意还有一类孩子他们从小到大脾气比较急躁一不顺心呢就乱发脾气这类孩子主要是在小的时候呀没有学会如何正确处理冲突和矛盾所以总是以激烈的这个情绪来对抗作为自杀的高危人群之之一家长们平常在和孩子相处的过程当中应该尝试着教孩子怎么样去面对冲突毕竟我们是跟他们接触最为频繁和密切的人第二种是深思熟虑的自杀从名字上来看这种类型的自杀不是一个结果而是一个过程通常想要亲生的人心里面会经历这么几个过程首先第一个是蒙杀自杀的念头其次内在有一个矛盾和冲突的阶段最后才是自杀的实施阶段在这三个阶段当中孩子会有一些异常的表现比如说孩子突然之间变得比较反常在最开始和大家说的安徽16岁高三女孩亲生的例子当中其实之前是有征兆的孩子在自杀前两天给母亲打电话说身体不舒服让她帮忙请假因为第二天就是月考所以家长在给老师请假的过程当中老师是直接表达了不愿意的这个时候家长就需要评估一下孩子以前他有没有过经常请假的情况如果没有到底是个怎么不舒服法导致从来不请假的他在考试前一天突然之间要请假他是真的身体不舒服还是说碰到了什么事情这些看似不起眼的信息其实在当时如果引起了足够的重视也许就不是这样的结果了除了反常以外有些孩子也会和身边的人去讨论离开死亡这样的一些话题甚至会网上直接搜索自杀的办法而这个呢正是孩子求助的一种信号如果这个时候他能得到周围环境的关注和支持很可能悲剧就不会发生了还有一点需要特别注意的是如果他开始和身边的人告别甚至分发一些他自己的物品那就是一个非常危险的信号一旦发现小孩有这种情况千万不要让他独处最好可以带他去寻找专业机构的疏导只有及早的干预才能够避免悲剧的发生事实上当前社会各个年龄段的学生自杀的事件越来越多从小学到初中到高中到大学甚至是博士这个现象背后是很多原因集结而成的应试教育的竞争孩子成长环境过程当中过于顺利导致心理承受力太弱学校心理工作不到位家庭教育的缺失等等若是想把这个问题根治无疑需要系统性的调整然而这并非一朝一夕之举那今天跟大家分享的呢是从发现自杀的征兆这个角度来减少悲剧的发生尽管它不能根治但是却是最后的救命稻草希望所有的家长都有这方面意识,并且能够引起足够的重视,毕竟孩子对我们来说是最为重要的。好了,那今天的分享就到这里,我是张慧老师,如果关于这个主题你有什么想交流的话,可以在评论区或者弹幕当中留言,觉得这个视频对你有帮助的话,别忘了点赞转发给更多需要的人。

U severnom Pakistanu, blizu granice sa Indijom, tu živi jedan od najdugovečnijih naroda na svijetu. Dolina je plodna i pogodna za poljoprivredu,de da žive Hunza ljudi do 120 godina, ali ostavimo po strani dokumentovanu starost i koliko je ona precizna. Lekari koji su pregledali populaciju Hunza ostali su fascinirani činjenicom da su starije generacije Hunza ljudi sasvim zdrave, vitalne i bez bolesti. Ovi ljudi uopšte ne obolevaju od raka. Stručnjaci su dokazali da je narod iz doline Hunza jedini kod koga se beleži potpuno odsutstvo kancera. Hunza narod konzumira uglavnom biljnu hranu, i to sirovu hranu. Hrana se pretežno sastoji od voća i povrća kao i žitarica, a troše i sir. Tokom leta jedu sirovo voće i povrće. Tokom zime jedu suve kajsije, ovči sir i proklijale žitarice. Koriste ono što im je na raspolaganju, pošto su prilično izolovani. Postoji period od oko tri mjeseca kada ne jedu ništa, nego samo piju sok od suvih kajsija. To je u proleće kada je i onako nedostatak drugih namirnica. Ovo je kod njih veoma važno i poštuje se kao što je u nekim kulturama važan post. Hunza ljudi su srećni. Oni su raspoloženi i rasterećeni. Način života je približan idealnom. Čini se da su oni zbog okolnosti i uslova u kojima žive dobili idealan režim ishrane za svoje zdravlje. Kupaju se u ledenoj vodi. Radiju djecu i sa 65 godina. Geni i čista sredina svakako imaju doprinos da ovi ljudi izgledaju mladoliko. Žive i rade u čistoj prirodi, su veoma aktivni i prelaze dnevno mnogo koraka. Pa čini se da je za njihov zdrav život ključna ishrana. Oni su vegetarijanci i jedu mnogo sirove hrane gdje dominiraju voće i povrće. Obavezno ispoštuju period gladovanja od tri mjeseca.

大家好,这里是点一滴生活坊在生活中,我们家里无理由玩手机还是看电视都需要使用网络为了家里每个地方都有信号所以我们就会买一个路由器但是家里的网速时好时坏很多人都不知道怎么回事又该怎么解决这个问题呢?下面我们一起来看看吧其实现在很多人为了方便省事,路由器就会一直插着,从来不忙这样做会导致路由器一直处于工作状态,其内部会产生大量的热量会导致设备及路由器内部线路的老化所以我们要先把插头拔下来这样相当于重启一次路由器,信号会得到加强然后我们将网线拔下来接着准备酒精和氧纤,收油器用的时间长了里面会堆积有大量的灰尘我们用免签沾取酒精,然后擦拭一下连接口酒精有很好的去污效果,而且还容易挥发。插好之后,我们再准备一个创可贴,将不用的插口用创可贴密封起来,这样可以避免让灰尘进入里面。然后再插回网线,这样就能够起到增强信号的作用。除了清理路由器之外,路由器天线摆放也很重要。现在的路由器有6-2根天线,3根或者4根等多天线路由器,很多人都会把路由器天线这样同一方向摆放,感觉比较好看。其实这样的做法是错误的。比如我们这个两根无线天线的路由器,应该一根竖着来一根横着来而多天线路由器可以将天线横放竖放斜放等多种角度方向组合总之不要将所有天线指向同一位置即可这样可以更为有效的覆盖空间提升WiFi覆盖率与信号强度使用上面的方法就可以让我们的路由器网速提高不少特别是在路由器后面贴上一个传口贴可以有效防止灰尘进入这几个提高路由器网速的方法大家都学会了吗好了今天的视频就分享到这里感谢大家的收看如果你喜欢的话请不请点赞加关注我们下期再见拜拜

A wilderness where one unlikely animal has tapped into ultraviolet light to get an edge over its arch rival. Alaska. This is an icy world in which one creature rules supreme. The wolf. This hunter patrols much of North America's snowy landscape. Their camouflaged fur allows them to blend into the snowy background. For a hunter, this disguise is essential. The wolf is a formidable hunter and in Alaska it pursues one animal relentlessly. Caribou or reindeer as they're known in Europe. These gentle giants seem vulnerable to the wolf pack. But the Caribou have a brilliant secret that helps them to see wolves coming. And it's all to do with ultraviolet light that is invisible to us and in this frozen landscape UV vision is a particularly powerful weapon snow reflects ultraviolet light so although we't see it, this is a world awash with UV. More importantly for the caribou, anything that doesn't reflect UV, like wolf fur, stands out against the bright UV background, even if it looks perfectly camouflaged to her background. If you're looking from a long way away against a big landscape, you find this wolf pretty hard to spot. This specially modified camera can see the UV light that's invisible to our eyes. Objects that reflect UV appear white and things that absorb UV appear black. The pictures are really clear. The snow is bright, bright white because the UV is reflecting off. There's loads of UV around in the snowy background. And then when the wolf comes into shot, it stands out because it's so dark. And that's because the wolf's fur absorbs UV light. The image is particularly striking because of the huge amounts of UV being reflected off the snowy landscape behind. And so for a caribou, being able to see in the ultraviolet is really useful. You'd see white snow and a very very obvious wolf. By tapping into ultraviolet light at this extreme end of the spectrum, caribou have stripped their arch predator of its camouflage.

电动车驾考费用公开,老百姓欲哭无泪,简直是在抢钱。近几年国内汽车保有量不断上涨,截止到2020年6月,汽车保有量已经达到了3.2亿。从汽车保有量总数来看,国内的汽车数量并不少,但是从人均汽车保有量来看的话,我国的人均汽车保有量仅为0.2,还是有很多家庭没有买上汽车。相相比汽车来说电动车更符合普通家庭的出行需求电动车的价格便宜骑行门槛低而且不需要驾驶证只要能够让电动车移动就可以骑着上路但是现在电动车不像以前那么自由了自从新国标实施之后电动车也增加了很多规矩如今电动车又增加了一项门槛考驾照。很多老百姓听说电动车要考驾照,觉得无法接受。自己买电动车就是为了图方便,现在不仅要挂牌,要戴头盔还得考驾照,这以后还怎么骑着电动车出门,不如骑电自行车考驾照这项规定,其实并不是现在才提出的,早在几年之前就已经提出了。但是电动车考驾照,针对的不是我们平时所说的电动自行车,而是电动摩托车和电轻摩。这两辆车虽然也被称为电动车,但它们的重量和行驶速度,已经超过了新国标对电动自行车的定义,因此需要持有电动车驾驶证,才可以骑着这种车上路。电动车考驾照也分为了理论考试和路考两个部分,理论考试和我们考CE驾驶证一样,考的都是道路交通法规和交通常识,只要稍微做一下题,基本都能通过。路考包括两个项目,一个是通过单边桥,一个是道路技能考试。通过单边桥就是驾驶着电动车,通过考场上的一个独木桥,只要车主在行驶过程中不停车,不掉离单边桥就可以。通过单边桥总分是100分,学员要达到80分才能及格。道路技能测试是一些关于驾驶操作的考试,这个操作基本比较简单只要会骑车都能通过道路技能测试的总成绩也是100分学员得到90分以上就合格当然电动车考驾照也不是免费的电动车驾考的考试费用是225元另外还有100元的培训费考出驾照之后制作驾驶证还要再交10块钱的公本费考一本电动动车驾驶证,总共要花335元。看到考驾照的费用不少,很多车主抱怨现在骑个电动车太不容易了。以前只要花两三千块钱买一辆电动车,就可以骑着上下班了。现在电动车还要进行分类,不符合电动车新国标的,度过了过渡期就得去报废。而且现在电动车后座载人也有要求,电动车后座不能载成年人。以前夫妻两人在一个工厂上班,挤一辆电动车就够了。新国标实施后,还得重新再买一辆电动车,又增加了一笔支出。电动车的保有量和汽车的保有量基本持平,它可以算是国内第二大出行工具。电动车确实非常方便灵活,也给人们的出行带来了很大的便利。快手也是为了规范管理、规范车主的驾驶行为。

A man who dedicated his retirement to rescuing animals built a train for formerly stray dogs and became a dog train conductor. 88-year-old Eugene Bostick said that he didn't originally plan to spend his retirement this way, and it was just something that happened. He lives on a large farm in Fort Worth, Texas, and unfortunately, a horse barn on his property became a local dumping spot for unwanted pets. Eugene and his brother Walter took the dogs in, giving them a safe place to live and proper care. Eugene was then inspired to create the dog train one day when he saw a neighbor using their tractor with carts attached to it to pull some large rocks. He looked at it and thought that something similar would be a perfect way to transport lots of dogs at once. And even though the dogs have lots of space to run and play on the large farm, Eugene wanted to do something special for them and be able to take them on little field trips. So he took some plastic barrels with holes cut into the side and welded some wheels onto them and then tied them all together. He started taking the dogs on adventures along quiet streets and through the woods about twice a week. Eugene originally ran the train with the help of his brother Walter, but since Walter passed at the age of 91 in 2020, Eugene has been carrying on the mission himself. He said that he's not sure how long he'll continue to operate the train given his age, but that the dogs really enjoy it and he'll do it for as long as he can. They are found in a variety of habitats such as savannas, forests, and wetlands throughout most of South America, including countries such as Brazil, Venezuela, Colombia, Peru, and Argentina. Capybaras are also popular as domesticated pets in some parts of the world. Capybaras are excellent swimmers and are often found in or near water. In fact, they are semi-aquatic animals, which means that they spend a significant amount of time in water to keep cool, to escape predators, and to find food. Capybaras have webbed feet and can hold their breath underwater for up to five minutes. They are also able to swim quickly and easily, making them well adapted to their semi-aquatic lifestyle. In addition to swimming, capybaras also enjoy soaking in water to regulate their body temperature and to clean their fur.
